info.title: AssetPulse Lite API
info.description: The implemented same-origin API for the AssetPulse Lite demonstration. Organisation, user, and role scope always come from the server-managed session; request input cannot select a tenant or elevate a role.

tags.name: Session
tags.description: Session authentication, CSRF bootstrap, and logout.

tags.name: Assets
tags.description: Read-only asset, sensor, and threshold configuration.

tags.name: Alerts
tags.description: Alert queries, lifecycle commands, and live invalidation.

tags.name: Work orders
tags.description: Assigned maintenance work and optimistic transitions.

tags.name: Demo
tags.description: Bounded legal reset of active demonstration state.

200.description: The HTTP process is available. This is not a database-readiness claim.

get.description: Creates or reuses the anonymous session cookie and returns the in-memory header token required by mutations.

200.description: CSRF token and required header name.
Trusted authenticated identity and organisation context.

post.summary: Sign in with a seeded account

200.description: Authenticated session and trusted identity context.

delete.summary: Sign out and invalidate the session
delete.description: Implemented by the Spring Security logout filter. The session cookie is cleared even though no controller method owns this route.

post.description: Legally completes at most 100 active alerts and work orders. Telemetry, history, audit, and cooldown records are preserved.

get.summary: Read an asset with sensors and threshold rules
Read a bounded sensor time range
get.description: The half-open request window must be positive and no longer than 24 hours.

200.description: Chronological readings in the requested range.

post.summary: Accept an atomic idempotent telemetry batch
post.description: Exact replay returns the original result. Reusing the key for different readings conflicts; one invalid reading rejects the entire batch.

get.description: Best-effort SSE invalidation only. Clients refresh authoritative alert state after ready, change, or reconnect events.

200.description: A ready event followed by zero or more alert-changed events.

X-Accel-Buffering.description: Disables reverse-proxy buffering for the event stream.

get.description: Technicians receive only their assigned work; administrators and viewers receive organisation-scoped work.

post.summary: Create a work order from an alert

201.description: Created work order with a Location header.

Location.description: Same-origin URL of the created work order.

204.description: Event returned to the bounded retry lifecycle.

sessionCookie.name: ASSETPULSE_SESSION
sessionCookie.description: Server-managed HttpOnly SameSite=Strict session identifier. It carries anonymous CSRF state before login and trusted identity context after login; organisation, actor, and role are loaded from server-owned data.

csrfToken.name: X-CSRF-TOKEN
csrfToken.description: Token returned by GET /api/v1/session/csrf and tied to the current anonymous or authenticated session cookie.

CacheControlNoStore.description: Prevents storage of session and tenant-scoped responses.

CorrelationId.description: Server-generated request correlation identifier. Client-supplied values are ignored.

CsrfToken.name: X-CSRF-TOKEN
CsrfToken.description: Session-bound mutation token from the CSRF bootstrap route.

RangeTo.name: to
RangeTo.description: Exclusive UTC range end, no more than 24 hours after from.

Problem403.description: CSRF verification or role/ownership authorization rejected.

Problem404.description: Resource absent or outside the trusted organisation/ownership scope.

Problem409.description: Current state, idempotency key, duplicate, bound, or optimistic version conflict.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until another sign-in attempt is allowed.

Problem503.description: Required authentication, audit, dashboard, or reset persistence is unavailable.

observedAt.description: Must not be in the future.

actor.description: Authenticated transition actor, or null only for a legacy assignment backfilled from pre-history data.

technicianUserId.description: Required same-organisation technician selected from the eligible-technicians route.
